esPINDMD.label: esPINDMD
esPINDMD.description: Clock and GIF player for pinball animations, driving a HUB75 LED matrix

matrix.label: Matrix
matrix.description: LED matrix showing the clock, the date and the GIFs

on.label: On
on.description: Whether the matrix is turned on, playback stops while it is off

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness of the matrix, with a light sensor connected this is the brightness in bright light

colour.label: Colour
colour.description: Colour of the text shown on the matrix, e.g. the clock and the date

gif.label: GIF
gif.description: Playback of the GIFs stored on the SD card

order.label: Order
order.description: Order in which the GIFs are played, sequential plays them in the order of the index

lightSensor.label: Light sensor
lightSensor.description: Optional BH1750 ambient light sensor on the STEMMA QT / Qwiic port, used to dim the matrix. Only present if a sensor is detected on boot.

illuminance.label: Illuminance
illuminance.description: Smoothed ambient light, null until the first reading and while the sensor is not responding

fullBrightnessIlluminance.label: Full brightness illuminance
fullBrightnessIlluminance.description: Ambient light at which the full brightness of the matrix is used, below it the matrix is dimmed logarithmically

minimumBrightness.label: Minimum brightness
minimumBrightness.description: Brightness of the matrix in the dark, limited to the brightness of the matrix

firmware.label: Firmware
firmware.description: Firmware of the device, updated over the air

latestVersion.label: Latest version
latestVersion.description: Version of the latest release, equals the installed version until a release is known

releaseUrl.label: Release URL
releaseUrl.description: Link to the release notes of the latest release

releaseSummary.label: Release summary
releaseSummary.description: Short summary of the latest release

inProgress.label: In progress
inProgress.description: Whether an update is being installed

updatePercentage.label: Update percentage
updatePercentage.description: Progress of the running update, null if no update is in progress

install.label: Install
install.description: Install the latest firmware, the device restarts on success
